newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-M.Lynch brings equity fund to Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-M.Lynch brings equity fund to Australia.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it has launched its institutional asset management operation and first institutional fund raising in Australia.
The fund would be called Merrill Lynch International Value Equity Fund.

Merrill Lynch Asset Management (Australia) Limited (MLAM) had been established as an associate of one of the world's largest global investment managers, Merrill Lynch Asset Management L.P. and would be initially seeking to raise funds from Australian institutions for investement in international equity markets.
MLAM currently manages US$234 billion in assets as of December 31, 1996 for institutions, government authorities, corporations and individuals throughout the world.

"We intend to make significant impact in the Australian funds management industry over time as we can offer truly global investment products and capablities to Australian investors, backed by the resources of one of the world's largest financial services firms," said Michael Davis, Director of Merrill Lynch Asset Management (Australasia) Ltd.

The launch of the Australian initiative followed the November 1996 acquisition by MLAM of a Los Angeles based institutional asset manager, Hotchkis and Wiley, which was now part of the Merrill Lynch Group, and the recent acquistion of McIntosh Securities in Australia.
Representatives of Merrill Lynch representatives were currently briefing a range of local insitutional investors and asset consultants about the international value equity fund.

"Merrill Lynch is very serious about the Australian market overall and we intend to become a major player in the Australian funds management market by offering local institutions access to our vast resources," Davis added.
